data.title: GOP Rep. Massie files impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie launched an impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth over the Iran war, while polls show voters remain uneasy about the conflict ahead of midterm elections.
data.keywords: United States,Congress,republican,Donald Trump,impeachment,Pete Hegseth,Secretary Of Defense
